verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents perform Sumsub operations on the user's behalf, with access governed by existing role permissions, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists. The evidence is a single short doc statement, so the depth of support is thin. Missing for 10: details on which operations or tools are exposed, setup and transport instructions for connecting agent clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
